title: There's a very simple reason why the resurgent Microsoft is threatening to overtake the slumping Apple (MSFT, AAPL)
text: There's a very simple reason why the resurgent Microsoft is threatening to overtake the slumping Apple (MSFT, AAPL) By Matt Weinberger Nov 29, 2018, 12:24 pm 30 pts Microsoft and Apple are jockeying for position as the world's most valuable tech company. It's easy to chalk this up to Apple's weakness – but don't sleep on the fact that it's also because of Microsoft's strength.
